WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, orders, (orders - lag(orders) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 1.0 / nullif(lag(orders) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) AS change_ratio FROM m ORDER BY month;

WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, sum(quantity * unit_price - discount_amount) AS amount FROM orders JOIN order_items USING(order_id) WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND order_status IN ('paid','completed') GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, amount, (amount - lag(amount) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / nullif(lag(amount) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) AS change_ratio FROM m ORDER BY month;
